card.text: Explore Prospero, a moon of Uranus, through its lightcurve-constrained shape approximation.

introduction.text: Prospero is an outer Uranian moon. Brightness variations support an elongated approximation, but several photometric periods are possible. The model uses a doubled, shape-driven period interpretation with assumed depth and orientation. The grid marks unmapped terrain.

model.title: Light-curve shape approximation
model.summary: Approximate ellipsoid from brightness variability, using an assumed-albedo 50 km size. Equal short axes and orientation are assumed; the doubled period is one interpretation of an ambiguous light curve. The grid marks unmapped terrain.
